import runpy
from itertools import combinations
import torch
from mmdc_clip_f.research.view_risk.baselines import *
from mmdc_clip_f.research.view_risk.head import *
from mmdc_clip_f.research.view_risk.head_inputs import prepare_raw_head_inputs
from mmdc_clip_f.research.view_risk.inputs import CANONICAL_VIEWS
from mmdc_clip_f.research.view_risk.fusion import RSNA_FUSION_PAIRS, DDSM_FUSION_PAIRS
from mmdc_clip_f.research.view_risk.targets import build_intervention_targets
fixture = runpy.run_path('tests/research/test_view_risk_head_inputs.py')['_features']
cached = runpy.run_path('tests/research/test_view_risk_baselines.py')['_cached']
torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.manual_seed(128)
cases=0
for backbone,width in [('vit_b_32',768),('vit_l_14_336',1024)]:
    candidate=RelationAwareConfidenceHead(RelationAwareHeadConfig(backbone=backbone)).eval()
    binary=SameInputMLP(backbone).eval()
    density=SameInputDensityControl(backbone).eval()
    counts=[count_trainable_parameters(m) for m in (candidate,binary,density)]
    assert all(abs(n-counts[0])/counts[0] < .1 for n in counts[1:])
    params=[{p.data_ptr() for p in m.parameters()} for m in (candidate,binary,density)]
    assert not (params[0]&params[1] or params[0]&params[2] or params[1]&params[2])
    print(backbone, 'parameters', counts)
    for tree in (RSNA_FUSION_PAIRS,DDSM_FUSION_PAIRS):
        order=CANONICAL_VIEWS if tree==RSNA_FUSION_PAIRS else ('L_CC','R_CC','L_MLO','R_MLO')
        mv=MaskedMVACNAdapter.for_backbone(backbone,legacy_view_order=order).eval()
        vilu=ViLUFailureAdapter(visual_width=6,text_embeddings=torch.eye(6)[:4]).eval()
        for size in range(1,5):
            for observed in combinations(CANONICAL_VIEWS,size):
                source=fixture(observed,hidden_width=width,fusion_pairs=tree)
                before=[x.clone() for x in source.all_tensors()]
                raw=prepare_raw_head_inputs(source,backbone=backbone)
                labels=torch.tensor([0,3])
                targets=cached(source.scores,labels,valid_removal_mask=raw.removal_valid_mask[0])
                visual=torch.zeros(2,4,6)
                for i,v in enumerate(CANONICAL_VIEWS):
                    if v in observed: visual[:,i]=source.projected_by_view[v]
                with torch.no_grad():
                    a=candidate(raw); b=binary(raw); d=density(raw)
                    m=mv(source.hidden_by_view,observed,classifier_prediction=source.prediction,current_scores=source.scores)
                    v=vilu(visual,raw.observed_mask,classifier_prediction=source.prediction,current_scores=source.scores)
                    for output in (a,b,d,m,v):
                        assert torch.equal(output.classifier_prediction,source.prediction)
                        assert torch.isfinite(output.confidence).all()
                    losses=[compute_same_input_error_loss(b,targets),compute_density_control_loss(d,targets),compute_mvacn_objective(m,targets,MVACNObjective.TCP_MSE),compute_mvacn_objective(m,targets,MVACNObjective.CORRECTNESS_BCE),compute_vilu_failure_loss(v,targets)]
                    it=build_intervention_targets(source.logits_by_view,labels,observed,fusion_pairs=tree)
                    losses.append(compute_view_risk_loss(a,it).total)
                    assert all(torch.isfinite(loss) for loss in losses)
                    ds=build_ds_features(source.logits_by_view,observed,fusion_pairs=tree)
                    assert torch.isfinite(ds.as_logistic_input()).all()
                    if size==1:
                        assert not a.auxiliary_valid_mask.any()
                        assert not a.effect_representations.any()
                    assert all(torch.equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(source.all_tensors(),before))
                cases+=1
print('PASS:',cases,'source-to-head/control cases; both backbones, both trees, all 15 masks; no optimization')
